assumptions: Simulation executes the actual repository refresh scheduler with a memory repository and a bounded fake provider; it is not production history.
180 daily runs, fixed current subject facts/status, starting 2026-10-17 01:00 Asia/Taipei.
Request costs include full type-0 API pagination; times include assumed per-request delay including pacing. No redirect/HTML fallback overhead is modeled.
Third scenario has provider unavailability on days 11-13. Manual snapshots are excluded from automatic coverage.
